Our FAQ Frequently Asked Questions

How can I check my passport status?

Enter your passport number in the Check Status box on this page. It shows the stage your passport is currently in.

I am an agent. Where can I see my passports?

Use Staff / Agent Login at the top of this page with the username and password given by our office.

Is Jahoss a government approved agency?

Yes. Our Govt. Approved Recruiting Licence No. is RL-2177.
